notes: v6.0 - THE FINAL POLISH RELEASE. NEW: Appearance themes in Settings (six themes + a custom accent colour picker; the welcome gate and PRO unlock card follow your theme), 4 new Text Animations (37 total), 4 new Graph presets (22 total), 2 new Quick Tools (Sequence Layers, Split Layer at Playhead), and a Setup health card that shows what is connected with one-tap fixes. FASTER AI: greetings and known commands are answered instantly on-device, CLI routes time out at 45 s and the whole route walk caps at about 90 s. DOWNLOADER: videos now prefer H.264 and are verified / converted after download, so After Effects can always import them. FONT FINDER: fast API vision routes first, local Ollama last. COPY SHAKE: one click - measure and the Reference Shake null is built in your open comp. The Gemini CLI was retired by Google for individuals; the panel now says so honestly and routes through the Gemini API key instead. Plus: Tracking card text fixed, text-animation fallback fixed, and a calmer, more consistent interface throughout. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
